policy_name: Four-Tier Real-Time Adaptive Payment Fraud Risk Policy

LOW.description: Standard legitimate transaction with normal behavioral patterns.

MEDIUM.user_message: Payment completed with routine telemetry monitoring.
MEDIUM.description: Low-to-moderate anomaly within acceptable customer risk tolerance.

HIGH.user_message: Additional verification required. One-time verification code sent.
HIGH.description: Elevated risk indicator requiring step-up multi-factor authentication.

CRITICAL.user_message: High-risk transaction detected. Verification required and security review opened.
CRITICAL.description: Critical fraud indicators: triggers challenge, opens SOC incident alert, and requires security authorization.
